events.title: Picked pitch §3: 999 / TA1 acknowledgment triage
events.summary: Net-new Sandbox demo — production-ops story after 837/835 demos.
events.rationale: 276/277 was already under construction; 999/TA1 was still uncovered and Low–Med difficulty — ideal for progressive theater.

events.title: Scaffolded stage Web UI before any routes
events.summary: docker compose --profile stage on :8129 with live Routes / Timing / Info.
events.rationale: Visibility-first playbook: stakeholders need something to watch in the first minutes, not after a silent 15-minute route grind.
alternatives: Finish all routes then open Web UI (old order)

events.title: Mount demo-eip-root/routes (no spaces in path)
events.summary: Web UI ROUTES_DIR binds to pilotfish/demo-eip-root/routes.
events.rationale: Docker Desktop often mounts paths with spaces (e.g. “EDI 999 TA1 Ack Triage”) as empty folders — that caused the earlier “0 progress” bug on 276/277.

events.title: Directory Listener for inbound acks (not HTTP)
events.summary: Poll input/ for .edi / .999 / .ta1; archive after read.
events.rationale: Clearinghouses typically drop acknowledgment files. Directory Listener matches ops reality and is trivial to smoke with sample files. HTTP fits real-time 270/271 façades better.

events.title: Classify with XPath + XSLT (no custom Java)
events.summary: Extract AK9/IK5/TA1 codes → AckDecision XML → Conditional Node Router buckets.
events.rationale: Playbook §3.4: prefer stock PilotFish modules. XPath Evaluation + XSLT + Conditional Node Router are honest demo topology and editable in eiConsole.

events.title: No SQL Server in this demo (on purpose)
events.summary: 999/TA1 triage is file-in / bucket-out — no DB lookup required for the story.
events.detail:
If we add payer-profile SQL later, expect events like:
INSERT INTO ack_rules (partner, reject_on_partial) VALUES ('CH01', 1);
events.rationale: When a demo does use SQL (eligibility, claim scrub, 837 SQL), the Experience log will show INSERT/SELECT excerpts under kind=sql so you can see the data kickoff. This pitch stays file-based to keep the ops-ack story crisp.

events.title: Record construction snapshots for Replay
events.summary: Each publish writes documents/build-replay/steps/NNNN + experience route events.
events.rationale: If someone misses the live build, Replay construction / Replay full experience can walk the same story later.

events.title: Test plan queued (stage theater)
events.summary: Next: tests/plan.json + run_interface_tests.py once EIP profile full is wired.
events.detail:
Planned cases:
1) Drop samples/999-partial-accept.edi → rejected bucket + ops report
2) Drop samples/999-all-accept.edi → accepted
3) Drop samples/ta1-accept.edi → accepted
4) Bad/unknown ST → error bucket
events.rationale: Show tests in the Experience log even before EIP is up so stakeholders see the validation path is part of the build, not an afterthought.
